item5_sub_020_hypothesis.verdict: REFUTED, and the selection bias is identified and measured
item5_sub_020_hypothesis.our_evidence_that_suggested_it: 5 venue-settled residual legs, 8.86 units, paid 0.1455/unit, redeemed 0.2235/unit = +0.0780/unit
item5_sub_020_hypothesis.the_selection_bias: those 5 legs were conditioned on STRANDING. A cheap leg becomes residual only when the complement never arrived, and whether it arrived correlates with the price move that also determines the payoff. Conditioning on the outcome is the bias; n=5 made it look like signal.

powered_test.source: L5 own fills, unconditioned on whether they later paired

item5_sub_020_hypothesis.conclusion: sub-0.20 is ADVERSELY priced, not favourably priced -- the opposite sign to our 5-leg sample, stable across a chronological split at z<-7 in both halves. The favourable end is 0.65-1.01 (alpha +0.0177, z+6.0), consistent with the favourite-longshot bias already in the record.
item5_sub_020_hypothesis.not_enabled: no flag, band or limit was changed. The hypothesis was tested and refused.

item6_highest_frequency_discrepancy.cross_check: final residual 8.88 median here vs 3.57 from the independent completion_vs_hold study -- consistent
item6_highest_frequency_discrepancy.the_discrepancy: ADD->ADD is L5s single most common transition at 36.5%, and our engine cannot ADD at all (imbalance_cap defaults to D(0)). He accumulates persistently same-side, carries a median 100-contract residual to settlement, and only works off 23% of his peak.
item6_highest_frequency_discrepancy.why_it_is_NOT_a_candidate: his residual sits at median own price 0.395, where HIS OWN fill-conditioned alpha is +0.0043 at z=0.8 -- statistically indistinguishable from fairly priced. OURS in that same band lost 0.3994/unit. Same price band, opposite fill-conditioned outcome. The difference is EXECUTION QUALITY, not inventory policy: his fills are size-scale liquidity provision, ours are 2 contracts resting 2 ticks behind a 52,000-100,000 share touch and therefore fill only when the market has moved against us. Copying ADD->ADD transfers the accumulation without the fill quality that makes it survivable.

item7_candidate_search.basis: REPLAY, 19 windows, chronological 11 train / 8 holdout, conservative fills, verified fees, incentives at ZERO
item7_candidate_search.result: NO arm beats the baseline holdout of -1.03. Every arm trades at 84%, so none of them is refusing trades -- the economics simply do not improve.
item7_candidate_search.depth0_is_INCONCLUSIVE_not_negative: the conservative fill rule requires the wire to trade THROUGH a resting price, which at depth 0 still demands an adverse move. The model therefore cannot represent a queue-priority fill at the touch, which is exactly what depth 0 is for. Evaluating depth 0 honestly needs a queue model -- the same missing input named before (our pre-submit rows carry our_position_within_level UNKNOWN).
